resources.string: Random quotes from history, every hour. Tap to reroll.
Random quotes from all of history. Not inspirational. On purpose.
“What, you egg! Young fry of treachery!”

To add the widget: long-press an empty spot on your home screen, tap Widgets, find Quote Vomit, and drag it onto your screen.\n\nIt pulls a new random quote from Wikiquote every hour. Tap the widget any time to reroll. If you\'re offline, it uses a built-in stash of old classics instead.
